name: Environment Variables
description: Provides an admin UI to view environment variables loaded from a configured .env file, plus an injectable service that loads that file via vlucas/phpdotenv.
project_description:
It provides an interface to view the user defined environment variables from the .env file.

It reads the .env file using the third party library 'PHP dotenv' (vlucas/phpdotenv).

The module also exposes a service that other custom modules can inject into their constructor to load the .env file.

In the configuration form, set the path to the .env file on the server.

Example:

 -> /../ (for a folder outside the docroot)

 -> / (for the docroot folder)

 -> /env (for a docroot/env folder)

More info:

 * For a full description of the module, visit the project page ( https://www.drupal.org/project/env_variables ).

REQUIREMENTS

 This module requires the PHP library "vlucas/phpdotenv".

INSTALLATION

 * Since this module depends on a third party PHP library, use Composer to install it.

 * Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 for further information.

CONFIGURATION

 * Configure the settings at Administration » Configuration » Environment Variables.

 1. After installing, an 'Environment Variables' item appears in the admin configuration menu.

 2. By default the administrator role can access the list URL; grant the view permission to other roles on the Permissions page if needed.
